releaseScope: 3.0-Q Q-P3 (qoder platform-side adoption): dirsearch has its capability snapshot frozen from a live read-only inquiry of an installed body, so the eight-step software gate can judge membership (C-4) and this platform can answer with a measurement. No capability, schema, recipe or selftest changed.
changes: capabilities.snapshot.json: frozen=true, generationMethod=live-readonly-probe, liveInquiry.perExecutable names the argv actually asked and the digest of each answer, and every capability carries liveConfirmation with the option tokens seen in it.
manifest.json: the version field only - the shape is closed, so "nothing else changed" is stated here rather than written into the manifest.
SOURCE.json: added, as every new release must carry (SW3).
unchanged: capability names, their schemas, sideEffects / consent / idempotent flags
recipes/, schemas/, selftest/, README.md - byte for byte from 1.0.0

evidence.rawAnswersKeptOnThisPlatform: qoder/runtime/maintenance/3.0-Q/runs/q3-freeze/live-text.json - a platform fact, so the bytes stay on the platform and only their digests are shared

crossPlatformNote: The body that answered is one platform install at the pinned upstream version. Another platform asks its own body: if the live list differs, the gateway answers SOFTWARE_DRIFT, which is what a frozen baseline exists for (BP-2: conclusions are not copied between platforms).
publishedBy: qoder, architecture 3.0 platform-side round 3.0-Q, step Q-P3
